APIs to automate management of cloud infrastructure for network functions.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `TelcoAutomationClient`: TelcoAutomation Service manages the control plane cluster a.k.a.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `TelcoAutomationClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudTelcoAutomationV1
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudTelcoAutomationV1.TelcoAutomationClient()
  let items = client.listOrchestrationClustersByItems(
    request: ListOrchestrationClustersRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-telcoautomation-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-telcoautomation-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudTelcoAutomationV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudTelcoAutomationV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-telcoautomation-v1
```
